mapper.update: UPDATE Alltotle a JOIN ( SELECT p.user_id, p.teacher_name, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN d.dict_label IN ('SCI分区Ⅰ区', 'SCI分区Ⅱ区', 'SCI分区Ⅲ区', 'SCI分区Ⅳ区') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS `SCI`, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN d.dict_label = 'EI期刊论文' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS `EI`, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN d.dict_label = '核心期刊文章（北大、 南大核心；社科类）' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS `hx`, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN d.dict_label = '三网收录论文' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS `sw`, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN d.dict_label = '普通期刊' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS `pt`, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN d.dict_label = '校办期刊' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS `xb` FROM sci_paper_a p LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data d ON d.dict_type = 'sci_paper_k' AND p.paper_category = d.dict_value WHERE p.state = 8 GROUP BY p.user_id, p.teacher_name ORDER BY p.user_id ) sp ON a.userId = sp.user_id SET a.SCI = COALESCE(sp.SCI, 0), a.EI = COALESCE(sp.EI, 0), a.hx = COALESCE(sp.hx, 0), a.sw = COALESCE(sp.sw, 0), a.pt = COALESCE(sp.pt, 0), a.xb = COALESCE(sp.xb, 0)
